policies.name: Allow service role all on documents
Allow service role uploads on documents
Business owners delete reports
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'customer-reports'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] IN ( SELECT (businesses.id)::text AS id
   FROM businesses
  WHERE (businesses.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.name: Business owners manage own documents
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'business-documents'::text) AND (auth.role() = 'authenticated'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] IN ( SELECT (businesses.id)::text AS id
   FROM businesses
  WHERE (businesses.owner_id = auth.uid()))))
